description: Empirical endorheic-basin targets from all nine non-Antarctic HydroBASINS v1.c standard Pfafstetter level-3 regions. Level 3 has 292 manually seeded terminal basin polygons. Generated terminal watersheds are resolution-dependent and are not a fully equivalent Pfafstetter hierarchy; the count comparison is therefore a coarse model-fit diagnostic, while the summed-area fraction is less sensitive to polygon subdivision.

sources.tolerance_basis: Five-percentage-point coarse terminal-basin model-fit tolerance. Generated coverage includes whole resolution-dependent watersheds with centroid latitude at or north of 60 degrees south to exclude Antarctica; generated units are not a Pfafstetter hierarchy and this is not a statistical confidence interval.

sources.source_geographic_coverage: All nine HydroBASINS v1.c regions; near-global non-Antarctic land coverage
sources.source_native_resolution: HydroBASINS standard Pfafstetter level 3, derived from HydroSHEDS 15 arc-second hydrography
sources.source_variable_units: fraction of level-3 basin polygons with ENDO > 0
sources.source_processing: Nine checksum-pinned regional DBF tables aggregated globally; ENDO values 1 or 2 counted as endorheic

sources.tolerance_basis: Eight-percentage-point endorheic-area model-fit tolerance. Summed terminal-watershed area is compared over generated coverage with centroid latitude at or north of 60 degrees south; HydroBASINS lumping and virtual endorheic connections remain semantic limitations, and this is not a statistical confidence interval.
